ranking_note: Authored before the first model-graded run; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are the sibling harness-ops skills and nearby skills in other plugins a request borders.

queries.request: Is anything in my plugin setup out of date? Don't touch anything, just tell me.
Before I start, would a sync change anything on this machine?
Which of my installed plugins are behind the marketplace right now?
Show me what a plugin sync is going to do without actually doing it.
Preview the updates and installs I'd get from the marketplace, read-only.
My project and user scopes may hold different plugin versions. Report it and change nothing.
Has my plugin fleet drifted? Just report.
A plugin I rely on may be old. Check it without updating it.
Give me a dry run of the plugin update.
Which external CLIs do my enabled plugins need that aren't on this machine?
List every skill and agent my plugins give me.
Why is my ~/.claude folder so large?
Does this repository's settings.json still match the docs?
Is there a known bug in plugin install on Claude Code?
Install the new plugins from the marketplace.
Check that node and jq resolve for the harness-ops hooks.
What changed in the latest Claude Code release?
